title: Direct collaboration
description: You work straight with the developer — no account managers, no hand-offs. Every decision and update comes from the person writing your code.

title: End-to-end ownership
description: Database schema to pixel to production — one person accountable for the whole stack, so nothing gets lost between layers.

title: Honest timelines
description: Estimates come with buffer built in, and progress is shared early — you find out how things are going before you have to ask.

title: Support after launch
description: Shipping is a milestone, not a goodbye. Fixes, tweaks and small improvements stay on the table once your product is live.
